summary: MZ73 job 1458 returned and work-side review accepted the six exact pre/fail MatRIS/AQCat25 prediction pairs. The largest cross-model movable-force disagreement is pre_06; the disagreement is a VASP-label sampling score only. No VASP, fine-tuning, path-rerun, micro-NEB, or Dimer job was submitted.

payload.objective: Obtain separate user authorization for the prepared six-structure SIGMA=0.20 eV VASP static force-label batch, then compare exact-structure MatRIS-VASP and AQCat25-VASP errors before deciding whether MatRIS fine-tuning is triggered.
current_evidence: User authorization was bound to request SHA-256 34e1a4dd41084fdf8df45bec6ba137bb3ecebeb8e928cba5285f1bf299251483 and limited to one MZ73 fixed-structure dual-model prediction batch.
Remote no-model preflight passed uploaded hashes, both frozen checkpoint hashes, shell syntax, Python compilation, request validation, and the six-file structure count.
Slurm job 1458 left the queue; MZ73 accounting cannot provide a terminal scheduler state, while the hash-bound producer exit record reports exit code 0 and success.
The returned prediction set contains six unique requested structures, matching structure and checkpoint hashes, finite model energies, and complete 50-by-3 force arrays for both models.
The largest MatRIS-AQCat25 movable-force disagreement is pre_06 at O-H 1.25 A: vector RMSE 0.183675 eV/A and vector max 0.624076 eV/A.
Cross-model disagreement is not calibrated uncertainty and does not establish either model's VASP error. Exact-structure VASP forces are required for the active-learning trigger assessment.
The six compatible VASP static force-label inputs remain prepared but unsubmitted.
payload.one_executable_step: Present the returned dual-model review; after separate explicit authorization, submit only the prepared six exact-structure SIGMA=0.20 eV VASP static force-label jobs to sunboquan-codex.
payload.submission_boundary: No VASP label, model fine-tuning, checkpoint promotion, complete-path rerun, micro-NEB, Dimer, or barrier action is authorized by the GPU submission message.
done_when: The user accepts the returned dual-model prediction review and separately authorizes or declines the prepared six-structure VASP static force-label batch.
If authorized, all six VASP jobs are submitted through their existing diagnostic_static preflights and recorded without any automatic training action.
